title: RPG MAKER MZ Plugin: Simple Trade System

posts.author: Undermax
posts.body:
Hi to Everyone!
I’m excited to introduce my brand-new plugin:
Simple Trade System
, designed to bring a robust and easy to use trading system into your games. This plugin provides an intuitive and customizable interface that can easily integrate with your existing projects.
Note:
For those who need even more advanced features, the
FULL version
is available as an upgrade, extending the functionality of the demo to meet more complex requirements.
The DEMO VERSION IS FREE.
More info about licence usage please press here.
